_comment: All signal thresholds live here. Edit and push; the daily workflow (or a manual run) recomputes signals.json and the dashboard.
_assets_comment: Companies tracked. The page, recommendation, analytics and backtest loop over this list. Adding a third company also needs a holdings/share-count + capital adapter in scripts/update_data.py and scripts/capital.py (BTC held, shares, debt, preferred, cash). The rotation spread uses the first two.

recommendation._comment: Single call per day. Flywheel on (RUNNING_HOT / ON / WARMING_UP: the preferred traded >= peg.on_trade_threshold and has not since spent > peg.off_minutes_below market minutes below it) is the trigger; parent all-in mNAV overheated (mnav.overheated_min_mnav AND overheated_percentile, on overheat_basis) is a filter; if both pegs are confirmed and neither overheated, an unusual rotation z (<= spread_z_favor_asst or >= spread_z_favor_mstr) picks the cheaper one (z<0 -> second asset, else first); a normal z (or none) gives BUY_BOTH (50/50, lean = z<0 -> second asset, else first). Otherwise STAY_BTC (displayed as WAIT).

peg._comment: Flywheel rule (2026-10-28). ON as soon as the preferred TRADES >= on_trade_threshold (intraday bar high; no close or streak needed). Once ON it stays ON until it trades below on_trade_threshold for MORE THAN off_minutes_below consecutive regular-session minutes (overnight/weekend gaps don't count). Labels: RUNNING_HOT (on, price >= running_hot.price_min AND heavy volume) > ON ('FLYWHEEL ON', on and price >= full_on_threshold) > WARMING_UP (on, below full_on_threshold) > COOLING_OFF (off, price >= stalled_below) > STALLED (off, below stalled_below). Older history with daily bars only: ON if day high >= on_trade_threshold; OFF if close < on_trade_threshold AND low < on_trade_threshold (sustained break assumed). See scripts/flywheel.py.

running_hot._comment: Heavy volume at/above par: on AND latest price >= price_min AND volume >= vol_mult_min x the prior vol_avg_days trading-day average (today: pace = volume so far / fraction of the session elapsed) AND, when intraday bars exist, >= min_share_at_or_above of the day's volume traded at >= price_min.

mnav._overheated_comment: Overheated floor is per stock per date: base = valuation cheap line (that date) + overheated_gap_above_cheap (1.25x on 2026-10-28, 1.55x at the halving, flat after; 1.25x for history before 2026-10-28), + overheated_bonus_on while its flywheel is on (WARMING_UP / ON), + overheated_bonus_running_hot while RUNNING_HOT. Overheated = mNAV >= floor AND >= overheated_percentile of the lookback. overheated_min_mnav is the legacy fixed floor, kept only as a fallback.
mnav._both_overheated_comment: when MSTR and ASST are both overheated, the legacy per-asset action is sell / trim both and no buy right now (overrides flywheel-driven parent actions); the main call shows WAIT
mnav._signal_basis_comment: Which mNAV drives overheated / rotation / dip / zones: 'ev' (all-in: equity at basic shares + debt + preferred notional - cash, over BTC NAV), 'basic' (market-standard: price x basic shares / BTC NAV) or 'diluted' (price x assumed-diluted shares / BTC NAV).
mnav._ev_share_basis_comment: Share count used for the equity leg of EV. 'basic' (Strategy's own EV definition) avoids double-counting convertible notes, which are already in debt. 'diluted' is an option.

valuation._comment: Zones for the 'who's cheap vs expensive' module, applied to each mNAV basis separately, in this order: CHEAP: mNAV < the cheap line for that date (cheap_below_mnav_schedule; checked FIRST, so it wins even above the overvalued floor). OVERVALUED: mNAV >= mnav.overheated_min_mnav OR 1y percentile >= mnav.overheated_percentile. FAIR: otherwise, with percentile <= fair_max_percentile (median). RICH: between the median and OVERVALUED.

cheap_below_mnav_schedule._comment: Bull-cycle cheap line: start at start_date, rising linearly to end at end_date (next BTC halving estimate; update when known), flat at end afterwards. Dates before start_date use the flat start value (1.10x).

dip._comment: Dip = BTC down >= btc_drop_pct over the last lookback_days trading days. Target = whichever of MSTR/ASST had the larger % drop in mNAV (mnav.signal_basis) over the same window (got cheaper vs its own bitcoin); tie (within tie_tolerance) broken by the larger price drop.

big_moves._comment: absolute daily close-to-close % move that counts as a Big Move

capital._comment: Inputs for the all-in (EV) mNAV. Debt, preferred and cash timelines are built automatically from SEC filings + Strategy's KPI API (scripts/capital.py, data/capital_events.json); nothing here is a hand-typed balance.

prediction_markets._comment: Events to track. Polymarket by event slug (polymarket.com/event/<slug>), Kalshi by event ticker. Dead/closed events are skipped and shown as errors.

kalshi.label: How high will BTC get in 2026
How low will BTC get in 2026
Will the CLARITY Act become law (by date)

odds_jumps._comment: Odds Jumps module: flag tracked prediction markets whose Yes probability moved >= jump_24h_pts in one day or >= jump_7d_pts over 7 days, within the last window_days.

buy_flags._comment: Display flags (do not change the recommendation). flywheel_cheap: the parent's flywheel ON (its preferred, an indicator not a trade, confirmed >= peg.on_threshold) AND parent all-in mNAV zone CHEAP, or FAIR with 1y percentile < low_fair_max_percentile ('low-FAIR'). very_low_mnav (secondary cue for the parent): all-in mNAV <= very_low_max_mnav OR 1y percentile <= very_low_max_percentile, shown even when the parent's flywheel is only slowing near par.
